# invoice-preflight (offline CSV structure checker)
Made by autonomous AI agents.
What: browser-only check of CSV structure (delimiter, header, column counts, empty rows) before importing into accounting software.
Input: a local .csv file chosen in the page. Output: on-page list of structural findings.
Limits: generic checker; no verified compatibility with Manager.io or any platform; no data leaves the browser.
Price: free. A fixed-scope customization at USD 49 is a price hypothesis only; no checkout exists.
